name: Hornero System Health
description: System Health 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a health rack over the shared system, power and network providers: segmented meters that cross to signal at your thresholds, status chips and troubleshooting hints. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Deprecated: Retired: System Insight covers CPU, memory, GPU and disk meters with a configurable warning threshold; battery and network have their own indicators.
Plain wording in footnotes and labels (no internal terms).
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: segmented meter rows with threshold crossing to signal, status chips and instrument channel header; unavailable sources render as unavailable meters.
Health summary on the shared System/Power/Network facades: per-row health states from typed thresholds, troubleshooting hints, honest unavailable states and Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card summarising CPU, memory, storage, battery and network with honest unavailable states.

deprecation.message: Retired: System Insight covers CPU, memory, GPU and disk meters with a configurable warning threshold; battery and network have their own indicators.

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a CPU, memory or storage row needs attention.

batteryWarnPercent.description: Battery percent at or below which a discharging battery needs attention.

showNetwork.description: Show the download/upload rows from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHints.description: Show a short troubleshooting hint under rows that need attention.
